name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: Gives an AI agent a web browser it can actually operate — open pages, click, fill forms — by reading the page's structure instead of guessing from a screenshot.
buyer: A small ops or growth team that needs to fill out the same web forms or portals over and over (applications, listings, submissions) and wants it done automatically, on any site.
business_use_cases: An agency builds an 'AI browses the web for you' service: automated form filling, account setup, and data entry across any web portal, without writing a custom scraper per site.
A testing company offers automated regression and accessibility checks for web apps by having an agent snapshot and diff pages after each release.
A lead-generation shop automates filling out directory listings or submission forms at scale for clients.

money_ideas.idea: SaaS wrapper for non-technical ops teams to automate repetitive web form workflows.
One-off custom web automation gigs for businesses with a specific painful manual process.

steal_this: Build a niche 'auto-apply' bot for a specific repetitive web task (e.g. submitting a business to local directories) and charge per successful submission this weekend.
